about: One table for the → (write in the message box) of the Durum panel: client.js statusInsert and draftTodo, Tether Core.swift statusInsert and appendLine. `now` is ms; the span of a time is the test stub "<seconds>s" (each app shows its own time format). The text never holds an id.
